name: decision-record
description: Turns a thread, meeting notes or a transcript into a decision record, appends it to a decisions log, and lists open decisions with days waiting and on whom. Nothing is marked decided without a named decider and their words from the source. Step 01 of the Landing Loop: reads the landing brief and the portfolio key, writes the decisions key of landing/<bet>.json in the Leader Report's decision format, and renders one HTML page.
